recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of two shirtless men standing back-to-back against a seamless white background. One figure tilts his head upward toward the light, while the other bows his head downward into shadow, creating a visual 'yin-yang' or emotional duality.
coreVisualRelationships: Opposing vertical head tilts creating a dynamic S-curve through the center
Physical contact at the shoulder blades establishing a central axis
High-key background isolating the detailed textures of skin and hair
Symmetrical placement of two figures against an expansive void
coreInvariants: Seamless white background with no visible floor line
Shirtless presentation emphasizing torso tattoos and musculature
Dreadlock hairstyles as a primary textural element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of contact between the two backs serves as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the upward gaze of the left figure, travels down the spine to the second figure, and follows his downward gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space above and to the sides of the subjects to emphasize isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing a sterile, high-contrast environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the hair and tattoos.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm mid-tones of the skin and subtle blue from a waistband.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright background and the shadowed contours of the bodies.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution studio photograph of two men with dreadlocks, shirtless with visible tattoos, standing back-to-back. The man on the left looks up; the man on the right looks down. Use a seamless white background and high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif font in the upper third of the negative space to maintain the clean composition.

verificationChecks: Are the figures strictly in profile?
Is one head up and one head down?

adjustableVariables: Amount of negative space above heads
mustRedesign: Specific tattoo designs to avoid copyright
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the back-to-back overlap
Ensure skin tones are consistent between both subjects
Verify the white background is blown out without losing edge detail
Confirm the 'up/down' head orientation is distinct
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + back-to-back pose + high-key white background + contrasting head tilts + textural hair/skin focus.
